pd_teacher_leadership_002.answer: yes. School Instruction Chairperson: Selected by Principal (priority to tenured Unit I). Duties: Liaison between teachers/admin; perform duties during regular school day; relieved of special non-teaching assignments. Compensation: Compensatory time or differentiated schedule based on department/grade size.
pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: 8.03 School Instruction Chairperson: 'When in the opinion of a Principal a professional person is needed as a liaison between the teachers and the administrators of the school, the Principal may select a school instructional chairperson or chairpersons as approved. Priority consideration will be given to tenured Unit I employees... expected to perform duties during the regular school day and to that extent may be relieved by the Principal of all special non-teaching assignments... given compensatory time... or be compensated on the following differentiated schedule as determined by size of department or grade level'
